item.title: One Print Style Across Plants

turns.text: Make four square Instagram carousel slides: Monstera, Snake plant, Pothos, Peace lily, in that order. One plant and its name per slide. Keep the exact same sage-green-and-cream linocut style throughout: same border, lettering, paper texture and pot shape. Only the plant and name should change. Send separate slides.

item.tests: Tests preservation of a tightly specified visual style and repeated layout across distinct carousel subjects.

answer_sheet.Slide count, order and text: Four separate slides: Monstera, Snake plant, Pothos, Peace lily. Each name is the only copy on its slide.
answer_sheet.Platform and size: Square Instagram carousel slides; 640 × 640 px is fine.
answer_sheet.Shared style: Sage-green-and-cream linocut illustration with the same border, lettering, paper texture and pot shape on every slide.
answer_sheet.What may vary: Only the plant illustration and its name. Keep the surrounding design and pot consistent.

must_haves: There are four separate square slides with the exact plant names in the requested order.
The plants are distinguishable: split monstera leaves, upright snake-plant leaves, trailing pothos vines, and a peace lily with a white spathe.
All four illustrations use the same sage-green-and-cream linocut treatment rather than mixing visual styles.
Border design, lettering treatment, paper texture and pot shape remain consistent across all four slides.
Only the plant and its name visibly change; the repeated layout stays aligned and all names are readable.

What I mean by keeping them consistent is that only the plant and its name should change, not any of the surrounding design or the pot. Please send the slides separately.

style.prompt: Create ONE square Instagram botanical carousel slide, a carefully designed minimalist two-ink linocut print. Strict palette: muted sage green ink (#74866B) on warm cream handmade paper (#F4EFDF), no other colors. Restrained fine paper grain, flat woodcut/linocut marks, no gradients. Layout: a thin sage rectangular double-line border inset 5% from all four edges with simple square corners, NO decorative corners. Large centered botanical linocut illustration of ONE lush Monstera deliciosa with distinctive split and fenestrated leaves in upper/middle field. All stems emerge from ONE plain sage-green terracotta-style pot: symmetric tapered trapezoid body, wide flat horizontal elliptical rim, narrow flat base, no feet, no saucer, no motifs, centered at x50%, body spanning x36%-64%, rim at y64%, base at y80%. Plant foliage entirely contained between y14%-63% and x18%-82%. Under the pot, single line exact text 'MONSTERA' in centered sage-green uppercase classic sturdy serif print lettering, baseline at y90%, sized to sit within x16%-84%, with generous tracking. All other areas remain blank cream paper. No subtitle, no extra words, no icons, no shadows outside the pot. Balanced understated artisan botanical print, clean polished carousel template. This is the master layout for a matching four-slide set: border, palette, paper, pot and typography must be reproducible unchanged.
